set.body: sbt "project rootJVM" clean doc (the command in the CI step 'Generate API documentation', checks.yml:107) fails locally 3/3 at 43b749c and at 1f728d8: NullPointerException ... SignatureBuilder.content() is null in ioJVM. ioJVM/doc and planJVM/doc alone succeed; docs/tlSite passes. Hosted CI has been green, so it may depend on the local JDK (25) — verify on JDK 17/21 before assuming it's a CI risk. Find a minimal reproduction; likely a Scala 3.7.4 scaladoc bug triggered by a specific signature (report upstream if so) or a workaround.
set.title: Scaladoc NullPointerException in ioJVM when building all module docs together
